SELECT time, concat(op, ' ', engine) AS series, value AS value FROM (
  SELECT time, op, engine, sum(d) / greatest($__interval_s, 60) AS value FROM (
    SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s, 60) SECOND) AS time, Attributes['op'] AS op, Attributes['engine'] AS engine, d
    FROM (
SELECT *, if(row_number() OVER w = 1, 0, if(Value < lagInFrame(Value, 1, Value) OVER w, Value, Value - lagInFrame(Value, 1, Value) OVER w)) AS d
FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum
WHERE MetricName = 'deskplane_mcp_web_requests_total' AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime - INTERVAL 10 MINUTE AND $__toTime
WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY ServiceName, ResourceAttributes, Attributes ORDER BY TimeUnix ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
    )
  ) WHERE time >= $__fromTime GROUP BY time, op, engine
) ORDER BY time, series

WITH samples AS (
SELECT *, if(row_number() OVER w = 1, arrayMap(x -> toFloat64(0), BucketCounts), if(Count < lagInFrame(Count, 1, Count) OVER w, arrayMap(x -> toFloat64(x), BucketCounts), arrayMap((c, p) -> if(c >= p, toFloat64(c) - toFloat64(p), toFloat64(c)), BucketCounts, lagInFrame(BucketCounts, 1, BucketCounts) OVER w))) AS deltas
FROM otel.otel_metrics_histogram
WHERE MetricName = 'deskplane_mcp_web_seconds' AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime - INTERVAL 10 MINUTE AND $__toTime
WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY ServiceName, ResourceAttributes, Attributes ORDER BY TimeUnix ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
)
SELECT time, concat('p50', ' ', op) AS series, value FROM (
  SELECT time, op, quantilePrometheusHistogram(0.5)(bound, cum) AS value FROM (
    SELECT time, op, idx, if(idx <= length(anyb), anyb[idx], inf) AS bound,
           toFloat64(sum(delta) OVER (PARTITION BY time, op ORDER BY idx ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)) AS cum
    FROM (
      SELECT time, bounds AS anyb, op, idx, sum(deltas[idx]) AS delta FROM (
        SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s, 60) SECOND) AS time, Attributes['op'] AS op, ExplicitBounds AS bounds,
               deltas, arrayJoin(range(1, length(deltas) + 1)) AS idx FROM samples WHERE TimeUnix >= $__fromTime
      ) GROUP BY time, anyb, op, idx
    )
  ) GROUP BY time, op
) WHERE isFinite(value) ORDER BY time, series

SELECT *, if(row_number() OVER w = 1, 0, if(Value < lagInFrame(Value, 1, Value) OVER w, Value, Value - lagInFrame(Value, 1, Value) OVER w)) AS d
